    Language support
   컴컴컴컴컴컴컴컴컴

      The commandline ACE archiver currently supports these languages:

    - Czech
	- Dutch
    - Finnish
	- German
	- English
	- Hungarian
	- Norwegian
    - Polish
	- Portuguese
	- Romanian
	- Russian
	- Spanish

      If you are interested translating message files into your language,
      please contact me at:

        email: mlemke@winace.com

      I will provide you with the necessary toolkit.



	Marcel Lemke/ACE Compression Software
